Name: Ithran
Summary: Ithran was a son of Dishon, the son of Anah, and a descendant of Seir the Horite.
KeyStory: Ithran is named among Dishon's four children.
RelatedPeople: Dishon, Son of Anah; Hemdan; Eshban; Cheran
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
